output.reason: The brief is convincing because three separate checks point to the same cause: stops with a tagged person nearby stayed flat, the eight robots still on 6.3 also stayed flat (a built-in control group), and the bench test shows 6.4 only triggers with the new film. It also explains why the wrap alone did nothing in August, and the action list is clear, though it says nothing about what happens to the 6.3 robots once support ends on 31 October.
